Method.evidence: The body is a serial-number normalizer: it strips a repeated MV- prefix (StartsWith(MV-) / Substring(3) in a loop) and cuts the value at the first hyphen (Contains(45) / Split(45)[0]) before returning it - literal evidence from --inspect-methods 0x060004C9 in Knx.Ets.HawkNET.dll.
Method.themes: Falcon/HawkNET IL work has begun: this row was named from its own literals, not from a cross-version oracle. The same inspection identified ft four byte-identical null-guarded wrappers around GetSerialNumberExtractor (0x060004D3/D4/D6/D7), which need their explicit interface owners before they can be named distinctly.
